description: Two old sports cars stand nose to nose on a concrete driveway in front of a tall green hedge. The camera holds on the front of an orange car on the left, with its round chrome headlight and chrome mirror, and the front of a yellow car on the right, with its indicator and chrome bumper. The camera moves slowly so the two fronts almost touch in the middle of the frame. At the end a man in dark blue overalls and a cap leans over the front of the yellow car and works on it.

en.question: What is the man looking at?

de.answer: Er sieht sich die Vorderseite des Autos an.
de.question: Was sieht sich der Mann an?

es.answer: Está mirando la parte delantera del coche.
es.question: ¿Qué está mirando el hombre?

fr.answer: Il regarde l'avant de la voiture.
fr.question: Que regarde l'homme ?
